body.personal_data_reach: Every repository, issue and setting the token owner can reach, including private code and collaborator e-mail addresses.

rules.description: Classic GitHub personal access token: ghp_ followed by 36 letters or digits.
rules.title: GitHub personal access token (classic)

verified.note: Regex adapted from gitleaks rule github-pat (MIT), retrieved 2026-10-31. Provider documentation not re-checked.

body.personal_data_reach: The repositories and permissions chosen when the token was created.

rules.description: Fine-grained GitHub token: github_pat_ followed by 82 word characters.
rules.title: GitHub fine-grained personal access token

verified.note: Regex adapted from gitleaks rule github-fine-grained-pat (MIT), retrieved 2026-10-31; \w replaced by [0-9A-Za-z_]. Provider documentation not re-checked.

body.personal_data_reach: Whatever the OAuth app was granted for that user.

rules.description: GitHub OAuth token: gho_ followed by 36 letters or digits.
rules.title: GitHub OAuth access token

verified.note: Regex adapted from gitleaks rule github-oauth (MIT), retrieved 2026-10-31. Provider documentation not re-checked.

body.personal_data_reach: Repositories the GitHub App installation can access.

rules.description: GitHub App token: ghu_ or ghs_ followed by 36 letters or digits.
rules.title: GitHub App user or installation token

verified.note: Regex adapted from gitleaks rule github-app-token (MIT), retrieved 2026-10-31. Provider documentation not re-checked.

body.personal_data_reach: Projects and groups the token owner can reach.

rules.description: GitLab token: glpat- followed by 20 word characters or hyphens.
rules.title: GitLab personal access token

verified.note: Regex adapted from gitleaks rule gitlab-pat (MIT), retrieved 2026-10-31; [\w-] replaced by [0-9A-Za-z_-]. Provider documentation not re-checked.

body.personal_data_reach: Identifies an AWS key; with its secret it can reach any AWS resource the IAM user can.

verified.note: Regex adapted from gitleaks rule aws-access-token (MIT), retrieved 2026-10-31. Provider documentation not re-checked.

body.personal_data_reach: Messages and member profiles in channels the bot belongs to.

rules.title: Slack bot token

verified.note: Regex adapted from gitleaks rule slack-bot-token (MIT), retrieved 2026-10-31. Provider documentation not re-checked.

body.personal_data_reach: Customer names, e-mail addresses and payment records in the Stripe account.

rules.title: Stripe secret or restricted key

body.personal_data_reach: Publishing rights to every package the owner maintains (supply-chain risk).

rules.title: npm access token

verified.note: Regex adapted from gitleaks rule npm-access-token (MIT), retrieved 2026-10-31; (?i) moved to the flags field; \s replaced by [\t\r\n ]. Provider documentation not re-checked.

body.personal_data_reach: Model usage billed to the account; prompts sent with the key.

body.personal_data_reach: Any Google API enabled for the project that the key is not restricted from.

verified.note: Regex adapted from gitleaks rule gcp-api-key (MIT), retrieved 2026-10-31; [\w-] replaced by [0-9A-Za-z_-]; \s replaced by [\t\r\n ]. Provider documentation not re-checked.
